ProjectName: Dabbler Platform / AcmeCoffeeOnline Security Dashboard (UAT Follow-up Fixes)

Review.Subarea: Per-Role Security Nav Visibility and Tab Gating
Review.ItemLabel: Baked-in User persona sees Security Dashboard nav entry and only Role Documentation tab

Steps.Action: Clear the dev email inbox so the "top-most" row you pick in step 4 is unambiguously the new magic-link message (navigate to /dev/email-inbox and click Clear if rows are present, or use the /test-auth/magic-links?clear=true endpoint).
Open the login screen at /login

Verifications.Text: The login page is visible (data-testid login-page)

Steps.Action: Fill the email input with `juser@acmecoffee.com` and click the "Send sign-in link" button

Verifications.Text: The login screen confirms the code was sent, displaying a "We sent a sign-in code to" message

Steps.Action: In a second browser tab, open /dev/email-inbox and look at the top-most data row (the first `tbody tr.mud-table-row` element — tbody scoping is required because MudTable also renders a header `tr.mud-table-row` in thead)

Verifications.Text: The first `<a>` inside the top row's `td[data-label="Link"]` has an href matching `^https?://.+/login\?token=` (points at the magic-link landing URL)

Steps.Action: Read the href of the anchor inside the top row's `td[data-label="Link"]` and navigate the original tab to that URL (the magic-link landing URL)

Verifications.Text: The Admin drawer group is visible in the left navigation of the authenticated app

Steps.Action: Navigate via the Admin drawer group to Security Dashboard (URL ends at /admin/security)

Verifications.Text: "Role Documentation" tab is visible
"Role Master Details" tab is absent (count 0)
"Default Masks" tab is absent (count 0)
"Organization Master Details" tab is absent (count 0)
"Users and Role Assignment" tab is absent (count 0)

Review.ItemLabel: Create organization auto-re-expands the shell and shows the new row without a shell-header click

Steps.Action: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role SystemAdmin
Navigate via the Admin drawer group to Security Dashboard (URL ends at /admin/security)
Click the Organization Master Details tab

Verifications.Text: Organization master grid is visible

Steps.Action: Generate a fresh 8-character hex marker you will reuse in steps 6, 7, and the verifications at step 8. Any 8-hex string works; this checklist uses `b2c3d4e5` as the example. The Playwright test computes its marker via `Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8)`.
Click the organization-grid-add-button button

Verifications.Text: The collapsed shell summary reads "New organization"

Steps.Action: Fill the Key field with `customer-followup-b2c3d4e5` (substitute the 8-hex marker you chose in step 4).
Fill the Name field with `Followup b2c3d4e5` (substitute the same 8-hex marker you chose in step 4).
Click the organization-save-button button. DO NOT click the shell header afterwards — the shell must re-expand on its own.

Verifications.Text: The results shell auto-re-expands within a few seconds — the organization master grid becomes visible without any shell-header click.
The row with key `customer-followup-b2c3d4e5` is visible in the grid (using the marker you chose in step 4).
The row with name `Followup b2c3d4e5` is visible in the grid (using the marker you chose in step 4).

Review.ItemLabel: Products Unit Price column renders the US dollar symbol (not the invariant-culture "¤")

Steps.Action: Sign in as jdoe@acmecoffee.com with role BackofficeUser
Navigate to /products
Wait for the product grid data to load

Verifications.Text: The Unit Price column header is visible in the grid (.mud-table-head)
The first data row's Unit Price cell text contains a "$" character (e.g., "$4.99").
The first data row's Unit Price cell text does NOT contain "¤" (the invariant-culture currency symbol).

Review.ItemLabel: Clicking a first-column cell collapses the shell on the first click

Steps.Action: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role SystemAdmin
Navigate to /admin/security
Click the Role Master Details tab

Verifications.Text: The role master grid is visible (data-testid role-master-grid).

Steps.Action: With the shell expanded, click directly on the BackofficeUser row's canonical-name cell (the first column's cell content, not the row's edge). Do NOT double-click.

Verifications.Text: On the FIRST click, the results shell collapses — the role-master-details-shell-summary element becomes visible.
The role-details-section is visible (the details panel renders alongside the collapse driven by the same row-select).

Review.Feedback: How can you run the test in a manner that most emulates the user.  Can you actually login with the login screen and navigate to http://localhost:5010/dev/email-inbox?, get the top-most entry (first tr element with class = "mud-table-row"), get the td with data-label = "Link" and then follow the link to login?  That's what the human does.
